subject: Next steps: ClearCart inference fit & pilot scope
messages:
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Cho <sam.cho@clearcart.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 25 Sep 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo: ClearCart inference needs + next steps

Hi Samantha —

Great to meet yesterday — thanks for walking through ClearCart's recommendation flow. Quick recap from our end and three asks so we can size a clean pilot: 

Recap notes:
- Workload: recommendation ranking + short personalized responses triggered at checkout.
- Rough QPS: you estimated avg ~600 qps with daily peaks ~2k for promotions; sustained peaks around 800 qps.
- Latency goal: p50 around 30–40ms, p95 target <150ms (you mentioned strict checkout thresholds).
- Typical request payload: ~40–60 tokens of input, often with a 512-token user-history prefix for a percent of requests (~10–15%).
- Security: SOC2 compliance needed; likely encryption + audit logs; possible interest in Private VPC later.

Three asks to finalize the pilot scope:
1) Can you confirm the expected sustained concurrency (sustained qps) and burst pattern (how long bursts last)?
2) Please attach any existing latency histograms or a short sample of request size distribution. This helps pick hosted vs dedicated sizing.
3) Are there procurement or data-access constraints (NDA in place?) that would limit us running a short benchmark with production-like traffic?

Proposed quick options we'll size once we have the data:
- Hosted pilot: Redwood Hosted API with reserved concurrency, KV prefix caching for history-heavy requests, and a pilot SLA window. Fastest path to start.
- Dedicated pilot: Reserved capacity (GPU pool) sized for p95 <150ms at your peak. Longer lead time but predictable latency.

If you prefer, we can run a 48-hour synthetic benchmark against both and share token-level cost/latency breakdown.

Attaching a short pilot scoping sheet (stub) we use to capture the distributions you mentioned.

Thanks — happy to jump on a 20-min sync if that helps finalize.

Best,
Dylan
Dylan Brooks
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: Samantha Cho <sam.cho@clearcart.com>

Cc: procure@clearcart.com
Date: Fri, 25 Sep 2027 11:05:17 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo: ClearCart inference needs + next steps

Thanks, Dylan — great recap. Confirming details and adding what we can share now.

Confirmations / clarifications:
- Sustained production QPS: 650–800 (US traffic) during peak hours. Bursts: up to ~2,000 qps but typically <5 minutes per burst during campaigns.
- Latency targets: p50 ~35ms, p95 target <150ms, p99 is less critical but we'd like visibility.
- Payload: median 48 tokens; 90th percentile ~140 tokens when including product history. ~12% of requests include the full user-history prefix.
- Use-case: recommendation ranking at checkout — failures or high tail latency directly impacts conversions.
- Security: We are SOC2 Type II and require TLS + customer-managed keys for any Private deployment. For Hosted pilot we need an NDA and limited data sharing (hashed identifiers ok).

I've attached a short latency profile from last month's sampling and our RFP PDF with procurement notes. NDA already in place with your legal team (I attached the executed copy earlier in the process).

Pilot preference: we are open to starting on Hosted (faster) if you can guarantee a benchmark that demonstrates p95 <150ms with our 800 sustained qps profile; if not, we'll need a Dedicated sizing recommendation.

Attaching: clearcart_latency_profile.csv, clearcart_rfp_q32027.pdf

Date: Sat, 26 Sep 2027 10:40:12 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo: ClearCart inference needs + next steps

Thanks for the data, Samantha — very helpful. Looping in Marissa (solutions) and Karthik (runtime) to propose two concrete pilot tracks and an evaluation plan.

Pilot tracks (what we'll execute next week once we have your benchmark dataset and NDA scope):
A) Hosted pilot (fast path)
- Config: Redwood Hosted API with reserved concurrency lanes (we'll set a concurrency reservation matching 800 qps equivalent), KV prefix caching for the ~12% history-heavy calls, and dynamic batching tuned to your token distribution.
- Goal: Demonstrate p95 <150ms for nominal 800 sustained qps and quantify cost per 1k tokens.
- Duration: 48-hour controlled benchmark + 7-day smoke in your staging.

B) Dedicated pilot (predictable latencies)
- Config: Reserved GPU pool (we propose equivalent of 2x A100-80GB-class nodes / or x86-optimized instances) with autoscaling headroom for 2k bursts.
- Goal: Achieve p95 comfortably under 150ms including 512-token prefix cases; capture unit economics vs Hosted.
- Duration: Provisioning + 48-hour benchmark; longer lead time for procurement.

Evaluation metrics we'll deliver: p50/p95/p99 latency, tail latency per token bucket, tokens/sec, EOS latency distribution, and token cost breakdown. We'll also share a small playbook on cache-key design to improve hit rate.

Next steps from us:
- Marissa: scope the benchmark infra and produce an estimated cost + timeline.
- Karthik: confirm Dedicated node sizing and the expected lead time for reserved capacity.
- Dylan: we'll draft a short mutual action plan + test plan and send for sign-off.

Samantha — can you confirm the person on your side who'll provide the staging traffic sample and the procurement contact? If procurement is ready, please loop them so Marissa can align the pilot terms.

Thanks — sending the pilot scoping sheet updated with your numbers.

Best,
Dylan

Dylan — this looks good. We're happy to start with the Hosted pilot track as long as the benchmark proves the p95 target under our sustained 800 qps profile. If Hosted shows gaps, we'll move to Dedicated sizing.

Procurement note: our procurement lead (procure@clearcart.com) confirmed a 2–3 week window to approve a pilot SOW; we can expedite for small POs. I've shared a staging traffic sample with Marissa this afternoon under our NDA.

Please proceed with the mutual action plan and include a short paragraph confirming data sharing limits (hashed identifiers only for the benchmark). I can sign the pilot SOW and we can slot the benchmark next Tuesday if your team is ready.

Thanks,
Samantha
